data: 6 DSS components per subject (dss1..dss6, misc, arbitrary units), 250 Hz, band-passed 1-10 Hz by the authors (causal FIR); 34 subjects (18 younger, 16 older); 23 trials x 58.5 s

tiers_not_run.mlr: impossible: shared data are DSS components band-passed 1-10 Hz (PSD -71 dB at 12-15 Hz, < -90 dB above 20 Hz) at 250 Hz; nothing in 30-60 Hz
tiers_not_run.brainstem: impossible: same reason (30-250 Hz band empty; 250 Hz sampling, Nyquist 125 Hz)

sanity.duration_note: neural trials are 58.5 s; stimuli are stored uncut (60.0-68.98 s wavs, the authors epoched 60 s from onset and 1.5 s were dropped for the FIR delay), so every trial is flagged (-1.50 to -9.66 s) by design; not an alignment error

misc_median_std_after_1Hz_hp.unit: arbitrary (DSS projections); no physical unit range check applies to misc

backward.method: ridge backward decoder, 6 DSS components x lags 0-250 ms, lambda 0.1 x mean eigenvalue, 64 Hz, 0.5-8 Hz zero-phase (effective 1-8 Hz), first 1.5 s of each trial dropped after filtering; LOTO within condition (per_condition_decoders) or over all 23 trials (pooled_decoder); nulls per held-out trial: 50 circular shifts (>= 5 s) and 7-9 mismatched attended envelopes of other stories not present in the trial; subject null = 2000 draws of one null value per trial (p floor 5e-4); population null = mean of subject nulls; lag sweep +-1 s in 15.6 ms steps (positive = stimulus delayed), parabolic peak, 95% CI by subject bootstrap; tolerance |peak| <= 1 sample (15.6 ms). Same-audio repetitions (snr0dB/snr-6dB/babble: each mixture 3x) are in the training folds of LOTO.

latency_trf.method: forward TRF attended envelope -> each DSS component, 128 Hz, 1-10 Hz, lags -200..600 ms, alpha 1, first 1.5 s dropped; per subject GFP over the 6 components and |TRF| of the auditory component (dss1, dss2 for R2594); peaks in 20-400 ms

repo_validator.note: repo cnsp_datasets.validate low tier = FORWARD encoding model (mean held-out r over the 6 components), first 1.5 s included, 50 circular / 20 mismatch nulls (p floors 0.0196 / 0.0476); babble: no mismatch null (one stimulus)

reference_datasets.note: sensor-level datasets, repo validator (forward model, mean r over sensors); not directly comparable to 6 DSS components / a backward decoder

pass_criteria: per condition: population p_circ < 0.05 and p_mismatch < 0.05 (per-condition decoders) and |lag-sweep peak| <= 15.6 ms
